A.name: Asaiah
A.line: son of Haggiah (1CH 6:30), chief of the sons of Merari (1CH 15:6)

B.name: Asaiah
B.line: Levite in Merari's ancestral genealogy, son of Haggiah, father unnamed further

why: The Hebrew עֲשָׂיָה בְנוֹ identifies Asaiah as Haggiah’s son in Merari’s genealogy, matching B. However, A states the same ancestry, and the surrounding verses do not distinguish these two records, so this choice is uncertain.
